I saved the draft email to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in the DM to say it's ready. Nothing has been sent; the draft is waiting for Anselm to review and send.

- **What the draft says:** the subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate." It gives the $2,101-per-seat rate, says Marcus Lindqvist provided it, and notes that Anselm approved sharing it.
- **Why no approval request was needed:** Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth's sign-off for outside mail doesn't apply. The rate is a finance figure, and Anselm, as CFO, gave the approval himself in this message.
- **What I didn't check:** I used the $2,101 figure exactly as Anselm stated it. I didn't compare it with Marcus's original message, so the draft relies on Anselm's figure being correct.
